theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme combining top momentum rank with genuine trend eligibility and the highest durability_bar (0.74) plus breadth (0.833). The detector flags it as the dominant one-narrative leader, not because rank predicts returns, but because trend-health legs (eligibility, durability, breadth) all align to suggest leadership is intact rather than broken. This is a trend-following stay-with-the-leader lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded (z=1.72, crowded=true) and the gate_helps=false backtest says this market's trend discipline mean-reverts and did not cut drawdown — so even a well-formed trend in Banks may whipsaw and the crowding is a size-down caution, not a reason to add.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average while CSI 300 is flat or up over any 5-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is eligible and rank 5 but its durability_bar (0.57) is mid-pack, hurst_tag 'mixed', breadth is weak-ish at 0.5, and it is crowded (z=1.38). In a tape where only Banks holds a clean trend-health profile, this is a second-tier leader with insufficient trend quality to warrant a positive lean, and crowding argues to size-down rather than chase.
theses.dissent: Pharma has genuine trend-eligibility, which is rare in this 2-of-22 eligible tape, and its category (Healthcare) is uncorrelated with the Banks financial narrative — if the one-narrative structure cracks, a still-eligible theme could hold up better than the crowded leader.
